name: OCKM-03
description: Lean monophonic acid bass synth: one oscillator, squelchy saturating diode-ladder filter with Overdrive, slide, accents and drive, plus a Pattern generator (hold a note to play a repeatable acid line), Mutate (repeatable octave jumps, slide-ins and rests) and a one-knob tempo-synced echo. Works with the MPC arp.
author: OCKM
